_about: Buyable non-gun items. Grenades go to slot 4 and are thrown with the attack key; C4 goes to slot 5 and is planted with it (seqPull = the plant animation). model = viewmodel in the player's CS install, worldModel = the thrown grenade / planted bomb.

rows.name: Kevlar Vest
rows.effect: armor 100, absorbs half of body damage

rows.name: HE Grenade
rows.effect: explodes after 1.5 s: 100 CS damage falloff over 7 blocks, no block damage

rows.name: Flashbang
rows.effect: pops after 1.5 s: blinds players looking at it within 20 blocks for up to 3 s, mobs within 8 blocks get Slowness+Blindness

rows.name: C4 Explosive
rows.effect: slot 5; hold fire 3 s on the ground to plant anywhere; beeps faster for 45 s, then blows up: hurts everything within 24 blocks (800 CS damage at the center) with a shockwave, and blasts a crater of about 12 blocks (obsidian included; 12% of blocks drop). Defuse: hold use on it for 10 s

rows.name: Smoke Grenade
rows.effect: after 1.5 s: thick smoke cloud of 4 blocks for 15 s
